callees.name: validate_base_url
callees.pre_condition: url is a non-empty string with leading and trailing whitespace stripped.
callees.post_condition: Raises an exception when url is not a syntactically valid absolute URL whose scheme is http or https. Returns with no effect when url is valid.

callees.name: adapter_for_api_style
callees.pre_condition: style is an ApiStyle literal value.
callees.post_condition: Raises an exception when style does not match a member of the recognized API style set. Returns with no effect when style is a known API style.

callees.name: validate_llm_setting
callees.pre_condition: name identifies a configuration setting category, and value is the candidate string value for that setting.
callees.post_condition: Raises an exception when value is not a valid member of the constraint set for the setting identified by name. Returns with no effect when value is valid.
